concerns.text: Task T011 reads `logs/resource.log` produced by Task T012, but T011 is listed **before** T012, creating a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation.
Task T011 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) yet depends on the output of Task T012; running them in parallel could cause missing or incomplete data, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe.
Task T012 is also marked `[P]` but writes `logs/resource.log` that is consumed by T011; this inter‑task dependency makes parallel execution unsafe.
Task T013 is marked `[P]` but validates all pipeline artifacts and writes summary logs and documentation; it must run after all preceding tasks, so the `[P]` tag is inaccurate.
